remaining_tasks.name: Replay command and movement completion correction
Class-based event registrations and hero ownership

blockers.description: User requested a session pause before executing the newly revised correction plans.

decisions.decision: Replay commands must not call shouldReplay; the user will place decorators on lower-level state mutation methods.
decisions.rationale: Replay is a verifier and should not mark its own command entry points.

decisions.decision: Movement and pathfinding replay steps must await controller completion before the next step.
decisions.rationale: A later route step must not overlap an unfinished movement action.

decisions.decision: Directional replay commands share one parameterized class; event registrations use explicit classes; eventTouchFront belongs to hero events.
decisions.rationale: Avoid duplicated replay classes and keep event ownership aligned with domain responsibility.
